acceptedIssues.mileage-difference-over-5-percent: The source overview is 1.0372 miles versus the existing 1.2-mile planning figure. The overview is clipped near an approximate access area; it does not establish the trip distance from usable landings. Retain 1.2 miles and disable distance/timing adoption.
